sessions.phase_label: Project scoping and initial illustration production
Illustration review, revisions, and final asset delivery

requirements.title: Bottle and Cloud-Text Illustration
requirements.definition: Create and revise the bottle-centered illustration with the slogan presented as cloud or sky text and with client-directed bottle wording and visual styling.
requirements.boundary_note: Bottle appearance, wording, typography, and cloud or sky treatment are attributes of one illustration; separately requested derivative PNG assets remain independent Requirements.

requirements.title: Stamped-Meat Illustration
requirements.definition: Create and revise the cartoon-style meat and tortilla illustration so the slogan appears stamped on the meat and remains visually unobstructed.
requirements.boundary_note: Cartoon styling, tortilla appearance, steak streaks, and stamped-text treatment are coupled attributes of this independently reviewed illustration.

requirements.title: Grill and Smoke-Text Illustration
requirements.definition: Create and revise the cartoon grill illustration with steak and onions and with the slogan rendered clearly in the smoke or associated text treatment.
requirements.boundary_note: Grill contents, steak shape, cartoon styling, and slogan readability are attributes of one independently reviewed illustration.

requirements.title: Final Illustration File Formats
requirements.definition: Deliver the completed primary illustrations in the client-specified PNG and JPG formats.
requirements.boundary_note: PNG and JPG are parameters of one final-delivery mechanism; design-specific background variants and isolated derivative assets can be requested and delivered independently.

requirements.title: Isolated Strawberry Composition PNG
requirements.definition: Deliver the requested isolated strawberry composition as a PNG with the bottle, grill, and smoke fully visible and with the unwanted pineapple wording removed from the bottle.
requirements.boundary_note: Cropping, retained composition elements, and bottle-label removal are attributes and corrections of one independently requested derivative asset rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Green-Background and No-Green-Background PNG Variants
requirements.definition: Deliver the referenced completed illustration as two PNG variants, one with a green background and one without a green background.

unresolved_candidates.description: Several revision and approval messages use attachment-dependent phrases such as 'this design' or 'this one.' The three core illustration boundaries are clear, but exact routing of these later messages cannot always be resolved without the omitted visual attachments.
The freelancer proposed next-day delivery after the client asked for turnaround time, but the supplied messages do not contain an unambiguous client acceptance of that specific deadline.

Feedback and revision support was discussed as a service term, but it appears to be project workflow supporting the underlying illustration Requirements rather than an independently evolving product deliverable.

human_review.decision_note: These messages identify illustrations through attachment-dependent phrases such as 'this design' or 'this one'; the omitted visual attachments prevent safe confirmation of their current core-illustration routing.

The generic 'changes done' claim may resolve to several immediately preceding illustration revisions, but the supplied evidence cannot safely establish whether it supports the two current claims, all three core illustrations, or a narrower subset.
The include-smoke update depends on the omitted proposal in message 64, while the visibility update may only repeat the cropping failure already recorded at message 63.
